answer: Price identity creation from its funding graph: when several identities draw funds from one source, each new identity must post a bond that grows quadratically, so a farm's tenth fake costs far more than its first. Bonds sit on a public onyx ledger, and a prism of independent auditors checks the funding links and flags hidden clusters. Honest newcomers in a shared orchard cooperative can still join cheaply by proving separate funding and distinct, checkable work, while one operator funding an orchard of fakes faces a bill rising faster than any reward.
